title: Quarks: the Unfolded Way
content: Although the EightFold Way theorem on quarks has led to a successful Stan- dard Model of the theory of particle physics, its Unfolding reveals unrecognized relationships and offers solutions to problems that have remained unsolved. In addition to eight documented ones, another is presented here, providing further evidence that the canonical postulates concerning the quark as electron-type Dirac particle and the nature of the top quark need to be revised.
